submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 with a 30 GeV threshold is recommended as it achieves the highest signal efficiency (85.273%) while satisfying all constraints. It outperforms Algorithm-L1 by 11.3 percentage points in efficiency. Algorithm-L3, despite potentially higher performance, fails the hard latency constraint and is therefore excluded. The 30 GeV threshold was identified as optimal through simulation, maximizing signal efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate while remaining well within the 20-60 GeV threshold range.
